GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( lugging bit on, Cross Over Nose Band on) began well, Took A Sit Just Off Mid-Field 5 Lengths . Straightened Up 3 Lengths off, couldn't quicken , began to tire Inside 100m # tired late/fitter

Jumped Ok couldn't muster any speed & went Straight Out The Back 9 Lengths . came very Wide on Turn Straightening Up 6 Lengths off. worked home fairly (rider stated horse wasn't suited by firm track) # passed a few
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: approaching the 600m became awkwardly placed on the heels of  a/r for a number of strides. RR in her opinion the gelding was not  suited by the firmer track.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok trapped Four Wide No Cover Off Mid-Field 8 Lengths . worked forward approaching home turn now out Five Wide Straightening Up 3rd 3 Lengths from the Leader . was Under Pressure when asked for an effort, Battled On Well enough to finish 4th # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced in the early stages of the event. Raced wide without cover  throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok raced keenly in between runners Mid Field 4 Lengths . steadied off heels near 1000m. was 5-6 Lengths off on Straightening Up , Made Some Ground but never looked like threatening # ok but no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages and improved onto heels  approaching the 1000m and had to be steadied. Again improved onto heels inside the 1000m and  had to be steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers 1st Time ) Jumped Ok Drifted Back Just Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths . Hooked Out Wide Soon After Straightening Up , ran on gamely to finish 2nd # finished off ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inconvenienced near the 1200m when another runner shifted in. Held up for clear running for a short distance rounding the home  turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field Two Wide With Cover 6 Lengths 1000m, came off heels and got to Middle Of Track on corner, had chance last 200m but did not finish well enough and missed placings # Even Effort

Jumped Ok , Settled touch Worse than midfield rails 5 Lengths 800m, worked off fence and between runners soon after Straightening Up , was Just battling at 200m when copped a squeeze and faded from then on # did not finish off
Jumped Ok Settled 6th 4 Lengths . laid out rounding home turn , was 3 Lengths off on Straightening Up , Battled On Well closing for 2nd # finished off ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out rounding the home turn. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex michael hickmott, Cross Over Nose Band off) Jumped Ok Settled Down in 5th 5 Lengths . inconvenienced at entrance to Straight , Battled On Well Hands And Heels # went ok/fitter
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 200m was inconvenienced when bumped by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out ended up 5th on rail 3 Lengths . failed to respond to hard riding in Straight (rider reported horse was one paced throughout) # see over further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. RR that the gelding was one paced throughout the event.
